personText.mappingScope: One raw continuous CPU Nemotron activity identity for the whole original meeting; no lexical or per-window identity fitting.

method.shortTurn: Consecutive reference events from one speaker in the selected clip, duration from first start to last end<=2 seconds; no inferred word times.
method.fullyDeletedTurn: Every lexical reference unit of this turn is deleted in the unchanged raw-text Levenshtein alignment; diagnostic association, not verified acoustic cause.
method.lexicalEdge: First/last3 reference units per clip, fixed before aggregation; not an acoustic boundary test.
method.englishTimeEdge: Reference word annotations within first/last1 second of the selected clip; deletions only. No Chinese word-time interpolation.
method.inspectionClasses: Mutually exclusive token-shape tags; no class is removed, corrected, or treated as harmless in acceptance.
method.diarization: Sum already scored raw multi-voice zero-collar errors, not exclusive attribution view and not newly rescored predictions.

diagnosticRepair: First attempt stopped before writing output: the assertion incorrectly required empty AMI vocalsound/disfmarker events to be word events. Empty lexical events are now skipped when building lexical turns; all nonempty events still require actual word annotations. Frozen reference tokens and all S/D/I counts are asserted unchanged.
limitations: Preselected exposed32 short clips; train diagnostics and validation stay separate. No blind or complete-meeting generalization.
Alignment placement can be ambiguous for repeated words; edit categories and edge associations do not establish causes.
No audio listening or new neural inference; no claim that reference spellings are acoustically adjudicated.
Existing whole Chinese score is reused; this inventory does not improve any recognition score.

limits.scope: This worker and its descendants only; no global or other-app changes.
